title: Era & yearly stability
summary: Compare the pooled eras with recent year-by-year results and a common September cutoff.

sections.title: Did the results survive a change in era or year?
sections.description: Compare 2015–2019, 2018–2019 as a coverage sensitivity, and 2020 onward. The recent annual panel covers 2023–2026. The common-cutoff table uses only January through September 18 each year.
sections.finding: The near side went first on 72.2% in 2015–2019 (n=306) and 73.3% from 2020 onward (n=1,514). 2018–2019 contributed 295/307 of the earlier inside-range sessions. 2026 ends September 18. The saved common-cutoff table applies that date to every recent year.
sections.caption: Boundary reach and first-touch rates by era and recent year, with Wilson intervals.
sections.alt: Boundary reach and first-touch rates by era and recent year, with Wilson intervals.

sections.title: How did overnight width and pre-open volatility change across recent years?
sections.description: Compare the annual median range, the median relative to the prior 60 eligible windows, and the pre-open volatility backdrop. The year-to-date columns use the same September 18 cutoff for each year.
sections.finding: Through September 18 in each year, median overnight width was 124.8 points in 2023 and 324.5 points in 2026. The trailing-width ratio and volatility medians help put the raw point change in context.

sections.title: Do width and VXN tell the same story in each era?
sections.description: Use the same fixed point and VXN bands in both eras. These cells contain different mixes of opening distances, so compare them with the held-out distance-adjusted analysis.
sections.finding: 2 of 9 cells in the earlier era and 9 of 9 in the modern era have at least 25 sessions. Rates in cells below that threshold are visually muted to counts. The saved distance table groups by near-target distance, and the scenario table groups by relative opening location.
sections.caption: Range-width and VXN matrices split by era, with small cells shown as counts only.
sections.alt: Range-width and VXN matrices split by era, with small cells shown as counts only.

notes: One unadjusted NQ contract per session. New York overnight hours are 18:00–09:30 and regular hours are 09:30–16:00.
The study covers January 2015 through September 18, 2026. 2018–2019 supply 295 of 307 earlier-era sessions.
Reel benchmark: Instagram reel Dfai3hHvMDn by @rithvikrishna64. Its exact sample and event definitions are unavailable.
Reaches use one-minute OHLC. The study describes price behavior and does not estimate trade execution or returns.
